working_memory.text: Engineers inspecting the Halden reservoir found cracking along the crest of the spillway and have lowered the water level by two metres while repairs are planned. The reservoir supplies three villages and a paper mill, none of which are expected to lose water because autumn rainfall has been above average. The repair contract will be awarded in October and the work is expected to take one dry season. Walkers can still use the reservoir path, but the viewing platform above the spillway is closed.
